items.title: Territorial Acknowledgement
notes: Councillor Roe opened the meeting with the following Territorial Acknowledgement:

We would like to begin by acknowledging that the land on which we are gathering from today is the land traditionally cared for by the Haudenosaunee, Anishnaabe and Neutral People. We also acknowledge the enduring presence and deep traditional knowledge and philosophies of the Indigenous People with whom we share their land today.

items.title: Moment of Reflection
notes: Councillor Roe provided Council with a moment of reflection.
At the beginning of this Council meeting, we pause to think about the needs of our community. May we show wisdom and compassion in all our decisions.

items.title: Sustainable Waterloo Region
notes: Tova Davidson, Executive Director, Sustainable Waterloo Region gave a presentation updating Council on Sustainable Waterloo Region’s past year, as well as on projects happening within the Region. She then responded to questions of Council.

items.title: Close-Out of the 2019-2022 Strategic Plan
notes: and the 2023-2026 Draft Strategic Plan
Report No.: CAO2023-019
Prepared By: Sandy Little
Sandy Little offered introductory remarks and offered a brief update on the current phase of the Strategic Plan.
Sarah Lewis, Manager, Deloitte gave a presentation outlining the draft vision, mission, and strategic priorities.

Irene O’Toole, Member, Waterloo Region Friends of Palestine spoke about the importance of community inclusion and visibility, and asked that anti-Palestinian racism be considered in the Strategic Plan’s Reconciliation, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion objectives. Sanjay Govindaraj responded to questions of Council.
Council then discussed the draft vision, mission, and strategic priorities. Sarah Lewis and Trudy Parsons, Strategic Advisor, Deloitte responded to questions of Council.
Sandy Little also responded to questions of Council.

items.title: New Business
notes: Councillor Wright wanted to note that it is Emergency Preparedness Week in Canada, and wanted to bring attention to the situations in Alberta and Quebec.

Councillor Vasic wanted to thank St. Agnes Catholic Elementary School for their bike safety event held on May 5, 2023. She also wanted to offer congratulations to staff, specifically Amy Ross, for the helping to organize the spring conference of Ontario Network of Accessibility Professionals.

Mayor McCabe spoke about Council for a Day, which happened on April 27, 2023, and how the youth give her hope with their great ideas and enthusiasm. She thanked the staff that organized the event, as well as the staff they visited on the day. Councillor Roach also commented on this, specifically mentioning that they had left him notes on his monitor, which resonated with him while they discussed the Strategic Plan earlier in the meeting.

Filipa Reynolds called attention to Tony Iavarone’s final Council Meeting, and offered her thanks to him for all the great advice he has offered over the years. Tony Iavarone offered thanks to the corporate management team and to the great staff he has worked with over the years.
